messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "oral administration recommended for MEC"
set: ["oral administration recommended for MEC", "parenteral administration recommended", "oral administration recommended for patients 12 years and older", "oral administration recommended for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "parenteral administration recommended for patients weighing 40 kg and greater", "parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 6 months to 18 years", "parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 1 month to 12 years weighing less than 40 kg", "use graduated oral syringe or measuring cup for oral solution", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "starting is not recommended", "postoperative administration is for nausea and/or vomiting within 2 hours after surgery", "wegovy flextouch pen not recommended for self-injection if visually impaired", "do not exceed recommended dose", "multi-day, single-dose administration of 24 mg orally for HEC has not been studied", "starting dose of 12.5 mg is recommended for adults over 65", "do not use in larger amounts or for longer than recommended"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
